name: student-learning-analytics
description: Full-stack learning analytics platform with RBAC, analytics dashboards and an explainable early-warning engine.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace server && npm run test --workspace web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace server && npm run lint --workspace web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace web
scripts.start: npm run db:deploy -w server && node server/dist/server.js
